logline.ko: 밤 11시 서울 자취방, 이란의 엄마가 영상통화로 묻는다. "뭐 좀 먹었어?" 딸이 꺼낸 건 미래의 햇반 — 페르시안 사프란으로 노랗게, 전자레인지 2분 만에 바닥은 바삭한 누룽지. 뒤집으면 이란 엄마들의 탓딕이 완성되고, 딸은 말한다. "햇반이 했어!"
logline.en: Eleven at night in a Seoul studio flat, a mother in Iran asks over video call: “Have you eaten?” The daughter reaches for a future Hetbahn — rice turned gold with Persian saffron, a crispy crust after two minutes in the microwave. Flip it and an Iranian mother’s tahdig appears. “Hetbahn made it!”

text.en: A mother’s cooking in two minutes — an Iranian mother’s tahdig (golden Persian rice crust) imagined as a Hetbahn that doesn’t exist yet

prompts.text: Front-camera selfie video call, vertical 9:16. The gentle Persian mother holds the phone with one outstretched arm (only that arm is visible at the lower-left edge); her other hand stays completely out of frame for the whole clip and she makes no hand gestures at all. Keep her exactly as in the start image: the same face, the same light grey-blue eyes, the same wavy honey-blonde hair, the same cream dress with crimson embroidery, the same kitchen with the brass samovar. Starting about half a second in, she looks into the camera with warm, caring eyes and speaks affectionately in Persian (Farsi, Tehrani accent), clearly and at a natural pace: "چیزی خوردی؟ پاشو یه غذای خوشمزه درست کن مادر" (Chizi khordi? Pasho ye ghazaye khoshmaze dorost kon, madar.) Accurate, natural lip movement for every syllable. After speaking she smiles softly, nods once and waits. Small natural handheld movement, natural blinking, kind relaxed eyes. Sound: only her voice and quiet kitchen ambience. No music, no subtitles, no text on screen.

prompts.text: Vertical 9:16 macro food photograph, photorealistic. A few deep-crimson Persian saffron threads drifting down in mid-air onto freshly cooked white rice in a white rectangular microwave rice tray; where the saffron threads land, the rice is blooming into a rich golden yellow. Next to the tray: a small ornate turquoise Persian ceramic dish piled with saffron threads, and a small clear tea glass of steeped saffron water glowing amber. Warm cozy late-night kitchen light, gentle steam rising, shallow depth of field, appetizing close-up. No people, no hands, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

title.en: How Many Times Did Engineering Save You Today?

status.en: Entry — 2026 NAEK “Value of Engineering” short-form contest (9:16)

logline.ko: 물을 틀고, 엘리베이터를 타고, 폰을 켜고, 길을 건너고, 불을 켜는 평범한 하루. 그 순간마다 공학이 개입한 횟수를 화면 구석의 카운터로 세어 간다 — 출처 있는 숫자만으로, 생성 영상 없이 전부 코드로 그린 60초.
logline.en: Turning on the tap, riding the elevator, waking the phone, crossing the road, switching on the light — an ordinary day, with a corner counter ticking every time engineering steps in. Sixty seconds of sourced numbers only, drawn entirely in code with no generated footage.

text.ko: '공학의 가치'를 설명하지 않고 세어 본다 — 하루 타임라인을 따라 카운터가 +1씩 올라가고, 마지막엔 세지 못할 만큼 폭주한다
text.en: Instead of explaining the value of engineering, count it — a counter ticks +1 along a day’s timeline, then runs away faster than anyone can count

text.ko: 화면의 숫자 9개 전부 공공기관·제조사 발표 수치, 장면마다 출처 표기. 확인 안 되는 숫자는 뺐다
text.en: All nine on-screen figures come from government or manufacturer releases, each scene cites its source; anything unverifiable was cut

text.ko: 키네틱 타이포 · 막대차트 · 링 게이지 · 카운트업 · 인천대교 선 그리기까지 모든 움직임이 시간 t의 함수(seek(t)) — 숫자 하나 바꾸면 그대로 재렌더링
text.en: Kinetic type, bar charts, a ring gauge, count-ups and the bridge line-draw are all pure functions of time (seek(t)) — change one number and re-render

text.ko: 96 BPM 패드 · 킥 · 아르페지오를 NumPy로 직접 합성, 카운터가 오를 때마다 음이 한 칸씩 올라가는 블립
text.en: A 96 BPM pad, kick and arpeggio synthesized in NumPy; each counter tick plays a blip one semitone higher than the last

text.ko: 없음. 실사 촬영도 없음 — 전부 코드. Claude는 대본 구성과 코드 작성을 보조
text.en: None — no footage either, all code. Claude assisted with the script structure and the code

prompts.text:
Read aloud in Korean, in a calm, warm nature-documentary narrator voice. Unhurried, with a clear pause (about one second) between each line:

바다에도 사막이 생깁니다.
해조류가 사라진 바위를 하얀 석회조류가 덮는 것, 갯녹음입니다.
수온 상승과 성게의 과도한 증가가 원인으로 꼽힙니다.
그래서 사람들이 해조류를 다시 심습니다.
바다숲 열일곱 곳에서, 해조류 무게는 백삼십팔 퍼센트 늘었습니다.
바다숲은, 다시 자랍니다.

It stands on a red Martian desert at golden hour, Earth faintly visible in the dusty pink sky. Full body, 3/4 view, centered, photorealistic with cute character appeal, soft cinematic light, 16:9, no text, no logos, no subtitles.
